comments.content: @pavlovcik Can you please make a decision on this bounty proposal?

### Intro
As I described [here](https://github.com/ubiquity/research/issues/79)  we should have at least 2 gift card providers set up and running.
Huuray provides a highly customisable solution for gift cards.
https://huuray.com/products/create-your-own-gift-card/
https://huuray.com/solutions/developers-gift-card-api/ 
I should fill out the questionnaire before the account is set up.
@pavlovcik please review this bounty
### Goal
Fill out the Huuray questionnaire to set up the Ubiquity account.
### Activity
- [x] Thoroughly review Huuray policies to realize their limitations
- [x] Fill out the Huuray questionnaire
Company name 
Country
Phone 
Basic company details 
Company VAT number
Company address
What is your reward model
Will you use gift cards/rewards internally and/or externally
Who are you rewarding
Countries where reward recipients are located
What are use cases for the API
How much do you plan to spend for rewards per year
### Time estimate
0,5 day

comments.content:
If we can issue credit cards via tpay I don't see the benefit of issuing gift cards. 
However I have uncertainty around their execution speed. Perhaps we can proceed with this as a backup plan and pull the plug if tpay can deliver, like this year.

When I get in my computer later note to self I need to increase the base-rate on this repo. Will update pricing soon!
Perhaps it would be most efficient to make a meta issue and batch together a weeks worth of work into sub tasks that I can approve etc 
Otherwise would also be nice to get @Draeieg 's input on these initiatives
Looks like rewards can not be generated for this repository yet because it is a private repository and we have not built those capabilities yet.
